sheet.title: Budget sheet
sheet.subtitle: Live worksheet across categories, activities and sub-activities. Click a cell to select, type or press F2 to edit, Enter and Tab to move — totals recalculate as you go.
sheet.formulaNote: Available = Budget − Committed · Variance = Budget − Forecast · Used = Committed ÷ Budget. Activity and category rows are formula rows and cannot be typed into.

newBudget.title: Add a New Budget
newBudget.subtitle: Classify each budget line, split it across the year by month and compare it against prior actuals. Add as many lines as the request needs.
newBudget.descriptionPlaceholder: Fills automatically once activity and sub activity are picked.
newBudget.remarksPlaceholder: Assumptions, dependencies or notes for the reviewer.
newBudget.overYearly: Over the yearly amount by KWD {{amount}}
newBudget.variancePrompt: Enter prior actuals to calculate variance.
newBudget.varianceHelp: Variance compares the requested total against prior actuals.
newBudget.attachmentsHint: Quotations and supporting files — each needs a caption.
newBudget.caption: Caption (required)
newBudget.upload: Click to upload or drag and drop
newBudget.captionRequired: Each attachment must have a caption
newBudget.captionWarning: Add a caption to every attachment to submit.
newBudget.requiredWarning: Every line needs location, department, activity, sub activity, year and at least one month.
newBudget.approvalNote: Budgets above KWD 50,000 route to the CEO for approval.
